text:
alex: Heads up — noticing a cluster of legacy orgs showing $0 / NaN on the Token Cost dashboard after last night's rollup. Saw a handful of support tickets. Anyone already digging?

sophia: I saw 47 orgs in the alert list, mostly created pre-2021. Dashboard graphs show flat zero, CSV export has NaN in the price column.

maya: Can you paste an example org id? I can try to repro in staging.

alex: org_79a4d, org_12b9c, org_3f77e — I'll DM full list (don't paste PII). It looks like the nightly aggregation job token_costs_rollup_v2 returned zero_cost when model_price was NULL.

kevin: tagging @billing-bot to check price ingestion. billing-bot: price-ingest status: last run 2026-03-16T03:20Z -> completed, 3 warnings about missing sku mappings.

sophia: quick SQL check I ran on prod read-replica (sanitized):

```
SELECT org_id, model_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens, AVG(model_price) as avg_price,
  SUM(tokens * COALESCE(model_price, 0)) as computed_cost
FROM token_usage_partitions
LEFT JOIN model_price_catalog ON token_usage_partitions.model_id = model_price_catalog.model_id
WHERE usage_window = '2026-03-15'
AND org_id IN ('org_79a4d')
GROUP BY org_id, model_id;
```

kevin: That COALESCE(,0) is the issue — rollup should fallback to last_known_price not 0. The migration to price_catalog_v3 introduced NULLs for legacy model aliases that weren't in the mapping table.

jamie: So two problems: (1) missing price rows -> NULL price, (2) rollup logic multiplies tokens * NULL -> becomes NULL/NaN and UI renders $0.

maya: Repro steps for support to include: 1) open token-costs for affected org 2) export CSV 3) filter price column for NaN 4) run the SQL above to confirm missing mapping.

alex: Customer impact: 3 enterprise customers reported discrepancies vs their invoices. Raised severity to P1 for billing-facing customers. Need quick mitigation for dashboard and a durable backfill.

kevin: Proposed immediate actions: (A) patch rollup code to use COALESCE(model_price, last_known_price, 0) where last_known_price is a derived column from price history table; (B) schedule a backfill job to populate price_catalog_v3 for legacy aliases; (C) re-run token_costs_rollup_v2 for impacted windows.

sophia: I can own (C) with ops help. Will need list of affected windows and org_ids. maya can run a one-off backfill script against staging and prod.

maya: I'll open a PR with backfill script and tests. Drafted statement for customers: "We're investigating dashboard display anomalies for some older organizations; costs are intact on ledger and invoices — this is a UI/aggregation bug and does not affect billing charges." Anyone want to modify copy?

jamie: That's good. Add: "We will re-run aggregation and follow up when dashboards reflect corrected values." Also include how to verify (CSV exported values match ledger line items).

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1143, priority P1, assigned to eng-analytics.

kevin: Quick mitigation for UI: change dashboard display to show "Data pending" instead of showing $0 when computed_cost is NULL/NaN. I filed a tiny UI PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/6421 — can someone review?

alex: Reviewed UI PR, one comment left. If merged we can reduce confusion while backfills run.

sophia: For triage notes: 47 orgs affected, primary root cause = price_catalog_v3 missing mappings for legacy model aliases after migration on 2026-03-14. Affected windows: 2026-03-14 through 2026-03-16 (inclusive).

maya: Backfill plan: run price_alias_backfill_v1 which uses historical price snapshots to populate missing model_price rows. Will mark safe-for-prod after smoke in staging.

jamie: Communication plan: notify impacted orgs via support with ETA ~6 hours for dashboard fix (UI + backfill + rerun). For enterprise customers, offer reconciliation assistance.

alex: @kevin please coordinate re-run. @maya please post PR link and prod run command when ready. I'll update support tickets and paste incident link.

kevin: Re-run command I will use (ops-approved):

```
kubectl exec -n analytics job-runner -- ./run_rollup.sh token_costs_rollup_v2 --start=2026-03-14 --end=2026-03-16 --orgs-file=/tmp/affected_orgs.txt
```

maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/881 — backfill script + migration test. Will run in staging in ~30m.

ops-bot: deploy starting: analytics/rollup-runner v2.4.9 -> rolling.

kevin: After the staging run I verified values matched ledger for sample org_79a4d. Will coordinate prod run in maintenance window in 45m.

alex: Support reply template ready, linking incident: "We deployed a fix and reprocessed the last 3 days of rollups; dashboards should show corrected token costs within the next hour. If you still see discrepancies, please reply and we'll do a manual reconciliation."

jamie: Postmortem TODOs: add guardrails to migration scripts to fail if any model_id -> alias mapping would be dropped, add a test that rollup computes non-null costs when historical price exists, and add a monitoring alert for NaN/zero spike > 10 orgs.

kevin: Leaving notes in the PRs. Will follow up with logs and the affected_orgs file after prod run.

alex: Thanks team — feel free to close thread when incident INC-2026-1143 is resolved.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-1143 status -> resolved by kevin at 2026-03-16T07:20Z, notes: re-run + backfill completed, UI patch merged.
